task: 为 OrderFlow 的 orderflow.refund 模块实现 SPEC-REFUND-014：按退款原因决定运费是否可退，优惠券按 SPEC-PRICE-003 分摊，并按 SPEC-REFUND-020 把单次退款金额限制为订单实付金额的 50%。需要实现的符号是 orderflow.refund.refundable_amount。

queries.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spec_item (
            spec_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
            title VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
            status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
            applies_to VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL,
            supersedes VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
            tags VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
            source_path VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
            revision INT NOT NULL,
            body MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,
            search_text MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (spec_id),
            FULLTEXT INDEX idx_spec_search (search_text) WITH PARSER ik
        ) ORGANIZATION = HEAP

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS code_symbol (
            symbol_id VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
            file_path VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
            module_path VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
            name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
            kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
            signature VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL,
            docstring MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,
            line_start INT NOT NULL,
            line_end INT NOT NULL,
            source MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,
            search_text MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (symbol_id)
        ) ORGANIZATION = HEAP

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test_case (
            test_id VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
            file_path VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
            name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
            module_path VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
            docstring MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,
            asserts MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,
            target_modules VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL,
            search_text MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (test_id)
        ) ORGANIZATION = HEAP
SELECT DISTINCT module_path FROM code_symbol ORDER BY module_path

SELECT spec_id, title, status, applies_to, supersedes, tags, source_path, revision, body, MATCH(search_text) AGAINST ('为 OrderFlow 的 orderflow.refund 模块实现 SPEC-REFUND-014：按退款原因决定运费是否可退，优惠券按 SPEC-PRICE-003 分摊，并按 SPEC-REFUND-020 把单次退款金额限制为订单实付金额的 50%。需要实现的符号是 orderflow.refund.refundable_amount。') AS fts_score FROM spec_item WHERE status = 'active'   AND MATCH(search_text) AGAINST ('为 OrderFlow 的 orderflow.refund 模块实现 SPEC-REFUND-014：按退款原因决定运费是否可退，优惠券按 SPEC-PRICE-003 分摊，并按 SPEC-REFUND-020 把单次退款金额限制为订单实付金额的 50%。需要实现的符号是 orderflow.refund.refundable_amount。') ORDER BY fts_score DESC LIMIT 40

SELECT spec_id, title, status, applies_to, supersedes, tags, source_path, revision, body FROM spec_item WHERE status = 'active' AND (search_text LIKE '%orderflow%' OR search_text LIKE '%orderflow.refund%' OR search_text LIKE '%refund%' OR search_text LIKE '%spec%' OR search_text LIKE '%price%' OR search_text LIKE '%orderflow.refund.refundable_amount%' OR search_text LIKE '%refundable_amount%' OR search_text LIKE '%为%' OR search_text LIKE '%的%' OR search_text LIKE '%模块%' OR search_text LIKE '%块实%' OR search_text LIKE '%实现%') LIMIT 40

SELECT symbol_id, file_path, module_path, name, kind, signature, docstring, line_start, line_end, source FROM code_symbol WHERE module_path IN ('orderflow.refund', 'orderflow.pricing', 'orderflow.service') LIMIT 80

SELECT symbol_id, file_path, module_path, name, kind, signature, docstring, line_start, line_end, source FROM code_symbol WHERE 1 = 1 AND (search_text LIKE '%orderflow%' OR search_text LIKE '%orderflow.refund%' OR search_text LIKE '%refund%' OR search_text LIKE '%spec%' OR search_text LIKE '%price%' OR search_text LIKE '%orderflow.refund.refundable_amount%' OR search_text LIKE '%refundable_amount%' OR search_text LIKE '%为%' OR search_text LIKE '%的%' OR search_text LIKE '%模块%' OR search_text LIKE '%块实%' OR search_text LIKE '%实现%') LIMIT 80

SELECT test_id, file_path, name, module_path, docstring, asserts, target_modules FROM test_case WHERE (target_modules LIKE '%orderflow.refund%' OR target_modules LIKE '%orderflow.pricing%' OR target_modules LIKE '%orderflow.service%') LIMIT 80

SELECT test_id, file_path, name, module_path, docstring, asserts, target_modules FROM test_case WHERE 1 = 1 AND (search_text LIKE '%orderflow%' OR search_text LIKE '%orderflow.refund%' OR search_text LIKE '%refund%' OR search_text LIKE '%spec%' OR search_text LIKE '%price%' OR search_text LIKE '%orderflow.refund.refundable_amount%' OR search_text LIKE '%refundable_amount%' OR search_text LIKE '%为%' OR search_text LIKE '%的%' OR search_text LIKE '%模块%' OR search_text LIKE '%块实%' OR search_text LIKE '%实现%') LIMIT 80
SELECT spec_id, title, status, applies_to, supersedes, tags, source_path, revision, body FROM spec_item WHERE status <> 'active'
